sentence: This project designs a computing chip that does its calculations inside memory so deep learning can run with less energy.
This project uses computer calculations to study how molecules can be designed for carbon-rich materials such as light-responsive polymers and nanotubes.
This project builds mathematical and computer models to study how the fruit fly wing disc changes shape as it develops.
This project builds methods and tools that help autonomous systems using machine learning cope with errors and respond to people.
This project studies how the brain forms lasting memories when a person learns different kinds of material that have similar structures.
This project builds hands-on and online learning activities about mechatronics, which covers robotics, mechanics and electronics.
This project studies how a chemical from tire wear disrupts the way human lung epithelial cells respond to stress.
This project builds a robotic system that can see and take apart small electronic devices such as cell phones, tablets and laptops.
This project builds methods for quantum computers to prepare the ground states and thermal states of quantum systems and studies when they work well.
This project tries to find out why large genome datasets still leave some species relationships unclear, and builds software to help sort this out.
This project builds computer methods to build and compare genome graphs, which hold the many genetic differences found in a population.
This project tests whether a living pharmacy can control blood glucose and weight gain in cats with diabetes and obesity.
This project builds a curriculum with three modules on robotics and automation for agricultural technology.
This project builds a large computing facility powered by renewable energy and studies how to manage science workloads on it.
This project studies how isolated piezoelectric transformers can help power electronics become smaller and work more efficiently.
This project studies how faculty adopt evidence-based teaching of ecology and whether a multidimensional framework changes their teaching.
This project studies how leopard seals may cope with a warming Southern Ocean by looking at how they move, their genetic diversity and their flexibility.
